name: NeutralButton
description: Provides a low-emphasis compact control, either icon-only or with a text label.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Sets the visible label. When set, the default slot is replaced by the label and the icon-left/icon-right slots.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders a native link to this location.

slots.description: The complete control content when no label is set.

slots.name: icon-left
slots.description: An icon before the label. Only rendered when a label is set.

slots.name: icon-right
slots.description: An icon after the label. Only rendered when a label is set.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Use small, medium, or large compact controls.
examples.markup:
<noora-neutral-button size="small" aria-label="Next"><noora-icon name="chevron_right"></noora-icon></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="medium" aria-label="Next"><noora-icon name="chevron_right"></noora-icon></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="large" aria-label="Next"><noora-icon name="chevron_right"></noora-icon></noora-neutral-button>

examples.title: Different icons
examples.description: Use the icon that matches the navigation direction.

examples.title: Text labels
examples.description: Use a label, optionally with icons, for low-emphasis text actions. The spacing matches the standard button sizes.
examples.markup:
<noora-neutral-button size="small" label="Button"></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="medium" label="Button"></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="large" label="Button"></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="large" label="Button"><noora-icon slot="icon-left" name="chevron_left"></noora-icon><noora-icon slot="icon-right" name="chevron_right"></noora-icon></noora-neutral-button>
<noora-neutral-button size="large" label="Button" disabled></noora-neutral-button>
